status: experimental assurance/review architecture; no production promotion
purpose: Append later review, challenge, corroboration, contradiction, correction, appeal, or reopening records to an original event without rewriting the assurance, evidence, decision, or finality that existed at the original event time.
required_bindings: superseding or corrective links where applicable
core_invariants: reassessment appends; it never mutates the original event
later assurance is not retroactive assurance
later contradiction does not erase historical evidence
correction creates a linked successor record rather than silently replacing the original
appeal and reversal change current interpretation/finality state without falsifying prior procedural history
unknown or unverifiable evidence remains explicit
review authority is distinct from runtime authority
a reassessment record cannot mint a new consequential effect grant
new evidence may reopen a previously accepted or finalized interpretation only through an explicit linked record
conflicting reassessments remain visible until a separate resolution process addresses them
nonclaims: This profile does not define a court, universal appeals body, or legal standard of review.
Reassessment does not prove objective truth merely because a reviewer is independent.
A later review may improve confidence without changing the historical assurance of the original event.
This profile does not authorize corrective effects by itself.
